name: codex-planning-stack
description: Planning-focused Codex skill bundle for brainstorming, architecting, review routing, and plan materialization workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Planning skills for brainstorm, architect, review, and materialization loops
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin that bundles the planning workflow skills used in this repository, including planning orchestration, brainstorming, executable plan drafting, cold review, test materialization guidance, and review wiki maintenance skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $planning to run the planning loop for this repository.
Use $brainstorm to resolve blocking planning decisions before architecting.
Use $architect to draft executable plans under ./plans.
